assertions.name: ohtsuki_kappa_tower_validated_as_kashaev_cumulants
assertions.source: All four corpus Ohtsuki κ_n reproduced as Kashaev-sum cumulants (complex-volume 𝔙_b=log Z coeffs) to rel err ≤ 2e-11 (κ₁ 1e-23); moment a₂ gives 0.885 ≠ κ₂=0.731 (the Z-vs-logZ category error). No fit; no c_k wired; L2 2/7.

description: First-principles validation of the corpus Ohtsuki κ-tower (κ₁=(11/108)√3π, κ₂=(2/27)π², κ₃=(1081/21870)√3π³, κ₄=(98/729)π⁴, derived #3628) from the raw Kashaev sum ⟨4₁⟩_N=Σ|(q)_k|². The κ_n are the CUMULANTS (complex-volume 𝔙_b=log Z coeffs): fitting log(⟨4₁⟩_N/[3^-1/4 N^3/2 e^{N Vol/2π}]) = Σ b_n(2π/N)^n by Vandermonde solve (260 dps, N≤51200, stable across fit order M=5..8) gives (2π)^n b_n = κ_n to rel 1e-23 (κ₁), 1e-18 (κ₂), 1e-14 (κ₃), 1e-11 (κ₄). Pins the moment-vs-cumulant (Z vs log Z) convention: the MOMENT a₂=b₂+b₁²/2 gives (2π)²a₂≈0.885 ≠ κ₂=0.731 (21% off) — a category error; only the cumulant b₂ reproduces κ₂. No fit (Vandermonde on exact Kashaev data); no c_k wired; L2 2/7. Independently validates #3628's tower (grounds the #3692 Borel resummation and the #3805/#3872 A_ω target).
